phase_goal: Historical recruitment-analysis exercise: establish a reproducible pool for profiling fullbacks who support wide build-up and ball progression.
identity: Group by team ID and player ID; retain all observed name labels and each qualifying start.
selection: All 52 fixtures represented by the existing seven-match and 45-match raw manifests. Read each team's period-1 Starting XI event. Count at most one qualifying role start per player per match.
exclusions: Wingback and other starting positions do not count. Substitute-only appearances and later role changes do not count toward this starting-role filter.
next_measurement: Audit playing-time denominators before computing activity rates; profile passing volume, progression and completion by role/side with match context. These performance measures are not calculated in this eligibility lesson.
scope: Fixed educational selection rule on already inspected 2019 data, not a preregistration, current transfer search, ability ranking or proof of stable role/minutes. Three starts is a sample filter, not a reliability threshold.
